headline: Small panels now expand as needed to prevent titles and section names from being cut off, with an optional setting to adjust width while open.

entries.title: Small bags preserve full titles and section names
entries.details: Small panels now automatically expand to the nearest grid step required to display the bag title and all section names in full instead of truncating them.

entries.title: Fit Names While Open setting for small bags
entries.details: A new option under Appearance > Size lets open small bags smoothly expand when longer names appear and shrink back down once they fit.
